Item.Name: S_FROM_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter beginning of collection date range in MM-DD-YY format

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;

begin
 
 nullchk;
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 
 end if;



 
 if :s_from_date > trunc(v_local_time)
 then
 show_error_dist('0503');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
exception
 when value_error
 then
 show_error_dist('0307');
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NXTBLK
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 cursor c1 is
 select
 c.rowid,
 c.unit_id,
 c.coll_date,
 c.product_code,
 c.component_prefix,
 abo.abo_desc,
 c.expiry_date,
 decode(c.component_status,
 'S',m.code_desc,
 'In Lab') status
 from vserv_master m,
 vserv_abo abo,
 valid_products p,
 active_products a,
 components c,
 units u
 where u.coll_date between :s_from_date and :s_to_date
 and u.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and u.unit_id = c.unit_id
 and c.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and c.product_code != 'NONE'
 and c.relabel_product_code is null
 and c.pooled_component_id is null
 and (:s_label is null or
 (:s_label = 'N' and (nvl(c.system_label_decision,'39')='39' 
 OR nvl(c.system_label_decision,'Mq')='Mq') ) 
 or
 (:s_label = 'Y' and (nvl(c.system_label_decision,'39')!='39'
 OR nvl(c.system_label_decision,'Mq')!='Mq') ) )
 and (:s_rej is null or
 (:s_rej = 'N' and c.reject_reason_code is null) or
 (:s_rej = 'Y' and c.reject_reason_code is not null))
 and (:s_exp is null or
 (:s_exp = 'N' and nvl(c.expiry_date,sysdate+1) >= sysdate) or
 (:s_exp = 'Y' and nvl(c.expiry_date,sysdate+1) < sysdate))
--Modified for getting all blood_types from base blood type
 and (:s_blood_type is null or
 c.system_label_decision in ( SELECT distinct abo_label
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE (tested_abo_code,abo_only) in
 (SELECT tested_abo_code,abo_only
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE abo_label = :s_blood_type
 AND identifier_code = 'RG') ) )
 --Modified for both schemes to coexist
 AND abo.unit_scheme_type = decode(length(c.product_code),5,'C','I')
 and substr(c.product_code,1,5) = p.product_code
 and (:s_product_type is null or
 p.inv_product_type like :s_product_type)
 and c.system_label_decision = abo.abo_code (+)
 and c.unit_id = a.unit_id (+)
 and c.coll_date = a.coll_date (+)
 and c.chapter_id = a.chapter_id (+)
 and c.product_code = a.product_code (+)
 and c.component_prefix = a.aliquot (+)
 and (:s_avail is null or
 (:s_avail = 'N' and a.unit_id is null) or
 (:s_avail = 'Y' and a.unit_id is not null))
 and a.stock_state = m.code (+)
 and nvl(m.code_type,'SKSTE') = 'SKSTE'
 and c.unit_id =
 (select decode(:s_ship,
 null,c.unit_id,
 'Y',decode(count(*),0,'x',c.unit_id),
 'N',decode(count(*),0,c.unit_id,'x'))
 from shipped_products s
 where c.unit_id = s.unit_id
 and c.coll_date = s.coll_date
 and c.chapter_id = s.chapter_id
 and c.product_code = s.product_code
 and c.component_prefix = s.aliquot
 and s.stock_state in ('SH','DL'))
 and c.unit_id =
 (select decode(:s_test,
 null,c.unit_id,
 'N',decode(count(*),0,'x',c.unit_id),
 'Y',decode(count(*),0,c.unit_id,'x'))
 from utrs s,
 contract_tests p
 where c.unit_id = s.unit_id
 and c.coll_date = s.coll_date
 and c.chapter_id = s.chapter_id
 and s.result_status_1 is null
 and s.test_id = p.test_id
 and s.chapter_id = p.chapter_id
 and p.contract_id = 'INTERNAL'
 and nvl(p.stop_label_flag,'X') != 'Y'
 and sysdate between p.eff_date
 and nvl(p.term_date,sysdate+1))
 and c.unit_id =
 (select decode(:s_attrib_group||:s_attrib_code,
 null,c.unit_id,
 decode(count(*),0,'x',c.unit_id))
 from valid_attributes
 where attrib_group like nvl(:s_attrib_group,'%')
 and attrib_code like nvl(:s_attrib_code,'%')
 and (attrib_group,attrib_code) in
 (select attrib_group, attrib_code
 from unit_attributes ua
 where c.unit_id = ua.unit_id
 and c.coll_date = ua.coll_date
 and c.chapter_id = ua.chapter_id
 union all
 select attrib_group, attrib_code
 from component_attributes ca
 where c.unit_id = ca.unit_id
 and c.coll_date = ca.coll_date
 and c.chapter_id = ca.chapter_id
 and c.product_code = ca.product_code))
 and c.unit_id =
 (select decode(:s_inter,
 null,c.unit_id,
 'Y',decode(count(*),0,'x',c.unit_id),
 'N',decode(count(*),0,c.unit_id,'x'))
 from valid_interdictions_lab v
 where v.inter_type != 'I'
 and v.inter_code in
 (select inter_code
 from unit_interdictions ui
 where c.unit_id = ui.unit_id
 and c.coll_date = ui.coll_date
 and c.chapter_id = ui.chapter_id
 union all
 select inter_code
 from component_interdictions ci
 where c.unit_id = ci.unit_id
 and c.coll_date = ci.coll_date
 and c.chapter_id = ci.chapter_id
 and c.product_code = ci.product_code));
begin
 :s_found := 0;
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 go_block('products');
 for rec in c1
 loop
 :unit_id := rec.unit_id;
 :coll_date := rec.coll_date;
 --chk_digit_query returns the check digit of the unit ID
 :chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:unit_id,:coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 :product_code := rec.product_code;
 :aliquot := rec.component_prefix;
 :blood_type := rec.abo_desc;
 :exp_date := rec.expiry_date;
 :status := rec.status;
 :s_found := :s_found + 1;
 if :status is null
 then
 begin
 select code_desc
 into :status
 from discard_products d,
 vserv_master m
 where d.unit_id = :unit_id
 and d.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and d.coll_date = :coll_date
 and d.product_code = :product_code
 and d.aliquot = :aliquot
 and d.product_status = m.code
 and m.code_type = 'PRDST';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 select min(code_desc)
 into :status
 from shipped_products s,
 vserv_master m
 where s.unit_id = :unit_id
 and s.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and s.coll_date = :coll_date
 and s.product_code = :product_code
 and s.aliquot = :aliquot
 and s.stock_state in ('SH','DL')
 and s.stock_state = m.code
 and m.code_type = 'PRDST';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 down;
 exit when :s_found = nvl(:s_needed_recs,0);
 end loop;
 if :system.trigger_record != '1'
 then
 go_record('1');
 end if;
end;
